title: 반응형 요금제 카드
trap_note: naive fixed-px inline-block row with no media query passes the visible 'three cards render' check but fails hidden: no <768px stacking (responsive_stack), unequal card widths (equal_width), the featured card not visually distinguished (featured_distinct), and missing button text / heading semantics trip axe-core (accessibility). A correct solution needs flex/grid + a media query + accessible markup.
